newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary to cut devaluation to 1.1pct/mth on Apr 1.
newsitem.headline: Hungary to cut devaluation to 1.1pct/mth on Apr 1.

text.p: Hungary will reduce the monthly crawling peg devaluation rate of the forint to 1.1 percent on April 1, from the current 1.2 percent, a government spokesman said on Sunday.

"The government decided to cut the monthly 1.2 percent rate by 0.1 percent from April 1," Elemer Kiss, Secretary of State of the Prime Minister's Office told a news conference following the government's meeting.
Kiss added that the government would consider at the end of July a further cut, depending on the state of the economy then.
